item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\n\\ndef probe(req,pol,expected):\\n    before=copy.deepcopy((req,pol))\\n    actual=evaluate(req,pol)\\n    assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)\\n    assert (req,pol)==before\\n\\np={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01,'km':1000},'unique':True}\\nprobe({'rows':[]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[],'errors':[]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':'zero','amount':0},{'id':'far','amount':1.5,'unit':'km'}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'zero','amount':0,'unit':'m'},{'id':'far','amount':1500.0,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':-1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'nope'},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'unit'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':False,'amount':-1,'unit':'nope'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'}]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':False,'unit':'nope'},{'id':'y','amount':1,'unit':'nope'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'unit'}]})\\nprobe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{**p,'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'m'},{'id':'a','amount':2,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('independent boundary probes passed')\"]}"}
